title: Privacy policy
body:
The data controller is Radical Books, Societat Cooperativa Catalana Limitada (Tax ID F10524965), registered at carrer Mestre Serradesanferm, 3, 08032 Barcelona. Contact: info@manifestllibres.cat. Orsini is a project linked to this cooperative.

What data do we process?

When you request information or register, we may process your name, email address, chosen course, the billing details required and the payment record. Technical data strictly necessary for the security of the service may also be processed.

For what purpose and on what basis?

We handle requests and registrations to perform the contract or take pre-contractual steps; we keep accounting information as required by law; and we protect the service against fraud on the basis of legitimate interest. Marketing communications will only be sent with separate consent.

Payments and providers

When online registration is activated, payment will be processed by Stripe. Orsini does not need to store your full card number. Hosting and email services may act as data processors; the final list will be set before registrations open.

Retention and transfers

We keep data for as long as needed to manage the registration and, afterwards, for the applicable legal periods. Providers may involve international transfers subject to GDPR safeguards.

Your rights

You can request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, where applicable, by writing to info@manifestllibres.cat. You can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).

Cookies

See the cookie policy and change your preferences with the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.

Privacy · Cookies · Legal notice

Registration form data

In addition to name, email and course, the form lets you optionally provide a phone number, address, postcode, town and level of education. This data is used to manage your registration and prepare the course; it is not used for automated decisions about access to courses.

Optional answer about collective participation

The field about political, social or trade union spaces is optional and does not affect registration. It may reveal special categories of data. At the current stage of the project only fictitious answers may be entered: real collection of this information has not been activated. Before activating it, the applicable legal basis, restricted access and retention must be defined and validated. The form includes a separate authorisation when an answer is written.

Tests, Stripe and registration emails

Information from the test form is stored in Cloudflare D1. Only the email address, the registration reference and the course and amount details are sent to Stripe; the address, level of education and the answer about collective participation are not. The confirmation email, once its sending service is configured, will only include the necessary course, payment and registration details. It will not include the optional answer about collective participation. Registration status is checked with a random credential; no list of participants is published.
